name: Load context for a bug fix in the validation module
description: Agent needs to load sufficient context to diagnose and fix a bug in validation helpers or operations without overloading tokens.
expected_outcome: Relevant validation files are loaded with high precision and minimal unused context.
common_failure_modes: Irrelevant memory bank files loaded
Missing validation_schema or validation_operations sections

name: Load context for adding a new MCP tool
description: Agent prepares to add a new MCP tool and needs patterns from existing tools, managers, and path resolver utilities.
expected_outcome: Existing tool implementations and path resolver patterns are loaded without unrelated docs.
common_failure_modes: Does not include path_resolver or cache_utils patterns
Loads too many unrelated plans

name: Load context for architectural review of the tool registration system
description: Agent reviews how tools are registered and categorized (tool_categories, __init__, prompts) to propose improvements.
expected_outcome: Tool registration and categorization modules are loaded with minimal noise.
common_failure_modes: Misses tool_categories definitions
Loads too many unrelated tests instead of core modules

name: Run pre-commit checks after adding a new Python module with tests
description: Agent runs the quality gate after new Python code and tests are added.
expected_outcome: execute_pre_commit_checks completes successfully without quality or type errors.
common_failure_modes: Type-check failures not fixed before rerun
Quality violations (function length, file size) left unresolved

name: Run quality fixes after modifying multiple files
description: Agent applies automatic quality fixes across several modules, then verifies with the quality gate.
expected_outcome: All lint/format/type issues are fixed and the quality gate passes.
common_failure_modes: fix_quality_issues fails due to connection issues and is not retried
execute_pre_commit_checks reports persistent type errors

name: Execute full commit pipeline for a feature addition
description: Agent runs the full pre-commit Phase A/B helpers before a feature commit.
expected_outcome: Preflight and quality gate complete with no blocking errors.
common_failure_modes: Phase A preflight not run before quality gate
Tests timing out due to missing timeouts

name: Create a plan for adding dark mode support
description: Agent creates a structured plan and registers it in the roadmap for a dark mode feature.
expected_outcome: Plan file is created under plans/, registered in roadmap, and ready for implement.
common_failure_modes: Plan not registered in roadmap
Roadmap entry missing plan path

name: Register a completed plan and update roadmap
description: Agent uses complete_plan to move a finished plan from roadmap to activeContext and archive.
expected_outcome: Roadmap no longer lists the completed plan, activeContext and progress are updated, and the plan file is archived.
common_failure_modes: Roadmap entry removed without updating activeContext
Plan file left in root plans directory instead of archive

name: Find and implement the next pending roadmap item
description: Agent uses roadmap and implement workflow to pick and execute the next pending work item.
expected_outcome: Correct next roadmap item is selected and its implementation is started with appropriate context.
common_failure_modes: Skipping blockers section
Not loading roadmap.md before implement

name: Read activeContext and update completed work
description: Agent reads activeContext, records newly completed work, and adds next steps.
expected_outcome: Newly completed work is recorded under the correct date with clear summaries.
common_failure_modes: Directly overwriting activeContext.md instead of using append tool
Incorrect date formats in entries

name: Validate all memory bank files and fix issues
description: Agent validates schema, duplication, timestamps, and roadmap sync for memory bank files.
expected_outcome: Schema, duplication, timestamps, and roadmap_sync checks all pass for memory bank.
common_failure_modes: Running validate without roadmap_sync check
Ignoring timestamp format violations

name: Search usage history for recent load_context calls
description: Agent inspects recent load_context calls using usage analytics to understand context effectiveness.
expected_outcome: Recent load_context usage is summarized for follow-up analysis.
common_failure_modes: Using low-level usage tools instead of consolidated query_usage
Not filtering by load_context tool name

name: Compact memory bank files at end of session
description: Agent compacts activeContext and progress files to reduce token usage, creates session handoff JSON, and applies progressive summarization.
expected_outcome: activeContext and progress are compacted, session handoff JSON is written, and token savings are reported.
common_failure_modes: Not creating pre-compaction snapshots for rollback safety
Failing to write session handoff JSON
Not applying progressive summarization tiers correctly

name: Validate memory bank with roadmap sync check
description: Agent validates memory bank files including roadmap synchronization to ensure no orphaned plans or invalid references.
expected_outcome: All validation checks pass including roadmap_sync with no unlinked plans or invalid references.
common_failure_modes: Not running roadmap_sync check type
Ignoring unlinked_plans warnings
Not fixing invalid plan references

name: Append progress entry using helper tool
description: Agent uses append_progress_entry helper to safely add a single progress entry without full-content writes.
expected_outcome: Progress entry is appended under correct date section using safe helper tool.
common_failure_modes: Using manage_file with full content instead of append helper
Incorrect date format (not YYYY-MM-DD)
Entry format violations (coverage percentages, phase names)

name: Append activeContext entry using helper tool
description: Agent uses append_active_context_entry helper to safely add completed work entry without full-content writes.
expected_outcome: Completed work entry is appended under correct date section using safe helper tool.
common_failure_modes: Using manage_file with full content instead of append helper
Incorrect date format (not YYYY-MM-DD)
Not creating date section if missing

name: Remove roadmap entry using helper tool
description: Agent uses remove_roadmap_entry helper to safely remove a single roadmap bullet without full-content writes.
expected_outcome: Roadmap entry is removed safely using helper tool without corruption.
common_failure_modes: Using manage_file with full content instead of remove helper
Not removing orphaned section headings after last bullet
Removing wrong entry due to non-unique substring

name: Run preflight checks before commit
description: Agent runs Phase A preflight checks (fix_errors, format, markdown lint, type_check, quality, tests) before commit pipeline.
expected_outcome: All preflight checks pass with zero errors, ready for commit pipeline Phase B.
common_failure_modes: Not fixing errors before proceeding
Skipping quality gate when violations exist
Not running all required checks (fix_errors, format, markdown lint, type_check, quality, tests)

name: Run docs and memory bank sync validation
description: Agent runs Phase B docs and memory bank sync validation to ensure timestamps and roadmap sync are correct.
expected_outcome: Docs and memory bank sync validation passes with no timestamp or roadmap sync violations.
common_failure_modes: Not validating roadmap sync
Ignoring timestamp format violations
Not fixing sync issues before proceeding
